module_summary: Traffic-light controller: a 4-state FSM cycles red/green/yellow via registered light flags, with a reloadable down-counter timing phases and shortened by pedestrian request.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Light FSM (idle, red, yellow, green); advances on cnt and drives p_* flags.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Phase down-counter reloaded on light changes; terminal value advances FSM; exported as clock.

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Registered red light output; falling edge versus p_red reloads cnt.

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Registered yellow light output; edge versus p_yellow reloads cnt.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Registered green light output; gates pedestrian shortening of cnt.

anchors.name: p_green
anchors.why: FSM-decoded green flag; with green detects phase change to reload cnt.

anchors.name: p_red
anchors.why: FSM-decoded red flag; feeds red output and cnt reload.

anchors.name: p_yellow
anchors.why: FSM-decoded yellow flag; feeds yellow output and cnt reload.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request; truncates remaining green time in cnt to 10.

groups.name: light_fsm
groups.description: State machine sequencing light phases and decoding next light flags.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: Down-counter reloaded per phase, shortened by pedestrian request.

groups.name: light_outputs
groups.description: Registered light outputs delayed one cycle from p_* flags.
